title: Network troubleshooting
text: A network connection timeout can result from packet loss. Check latency, router connectivity and the server address.

title: Database backups
text: Create database backups before migrations. Verify restore procedures and retention policies.

title: Frame performance
text: High frame time reduces rendering performance. Profile CPU and GPU workloads to investigate frame drops.

title: Account security
text: Enable multifactor authentication. Do not share passwords or access tokens.

title: Missing data
text: Missing numerical sensor values can be imputed with a median. Report missing counts before cleaning.

title: Application deployment
text: Test the application build before deployment. Record versions and prepare a rollback procedure.

title: Session logging
text: Export simulation session logs as CSV with a session identifier, timestamp and numerical measurements.

title: Model evaluation
text: Split training and test data before fitting a model. Compare validation metrics against a baseline.
